## Rows

| dice | result | effect | severity | notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 11-13 | False Trail | You mistake an animal track or wash for the true path. The group wastes a Quarter Day following the wrong route. | Moderate |  |
| 14-16 | Bad Water | You choose a tainted spring, muddy pool, or stagnant runoff as a safe source. Everyone who drinks risks sickness at the GM's discretion. | High |  |
| 21-23 | Cold Camp March | You press on through bad ground without proper shelter or pacing. Suffer 1 point of damage to Strength from fatigue and exposure. | Moderate |  |
| 24-26 | Lost Bearings | You lose your sense of direction among trees, hills, or mist. The group makes no progress this Quarter Day. | High |  |
| 31-33 | Spoiled Supplies | Your travel methods ruin or spill essential rations or water. Reduce one relevant Resource Die by one step for the group. | Moderate |  |
| 34-36 | Exhausting Detour | You choose terrain that is passable but brutally inefficient. Everyone in the group suffers 1 point of damage to Agility or Strength, GM's choice. | High |  |
| 41-43 | Predator Sign Missed | You fail to read the signs of a nearby predator. A dangerous beast finds your group before you are ready. | High |  |
| 44-46 | Unsafe Crossing | You lead the group across unstable ground, thin ice, or a bad ford. Each adventurer must make a MOVE roll or suffer an attack with four Base Dice. | High |  |
| 51-53 | Night Without Rest | Your chosen resting place offers no real shelter from damp, wind, or insects. No one in the group gets any SLEEP until a better camp is found. | Severe |  |
| 54-56 | Poison Growth | You guide the group toward edible-looking plants or fungi that are actually dangerous. A meal prepared from them carries a poison of Potency 3. | High |  |
| 61-63 | Dead End Country | You lead the group into terrain that cannot be crossed without climbing back out, circling wide, or abandoning gear. Lose a Quarter Day and one useful item, GM's choice. | Severe |  |
| 64-66 | Wilderness Claim | Your error leaves the group stranded in deadly country with failing supplies and danger closing in. The GM introduces an immediate survival crisis. | Catastrophic |  |
